temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa seems overburdened with her tasks during the community service project and initially says she can manage, though Arthur notices she is overwhelmed.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: He had no specific prior belief that Teresa needed help; he only becomes aware of her burden as he observes her working.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he forms the belief that Teresa needs help and that her well-being may be at risk if she continues alone.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa needs help and is overburdened; Arthur can assist her with some tasks.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Concerned and worried for Teresa's well-being.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Offer his assistance and help Teresa with her tasks.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa is hesitant to accept help and expresses a desire to show that she can do things by herself.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is overburdened and needs help; Arthur has offered assistance, but he is unsure why she resists accepting it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he now believes Teresa's hesitation comes from a desire to prove her capability and be self-reliant.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa wants to prove she is capable, but accepting help does not undermine her abilities; teamwork can be more effective.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Empathetic and understanding toward Teresa's desire to be self-reliant.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Reassure Teresa that accepting help does not mean she is incapable and encourage a teamwork approach.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Despite Arthur's reassurance, Teresa still appears to be struggling and falling behind.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa was hesitant because she wanted to prove her capability, but Arthur believed his reassurance and help would ease her burden.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he realizes his reassurance and current helping approach have not resolved Teresa's struggle.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Teresa is still struggling; Arthur needs another way to support her without making her feel inadequate.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Frustrated and concerned that his efforts are not yielding results.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Find a different approach, such as working together on tasks, to support Teresa without undermining her confidence.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Teresa agrees to the collaborative approach and says working together already feels less overwhelming.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Teresa is still struggling, so Arthur proposed working together as a team; she agreed to try it.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; he becomes more confident that collaboration will ease Teresa's burden and improve their efficiency.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Working together will be effective, ease Teresa's burden, and help them accomplish more.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Fully commit to the collaborative approach: divide tasks, check in regularly, and keep the momentum going.

temporal_state_chain.observed: Their teamwork has paid off, they accomplished much more together, and Teresa agrees that working collaboratively has been a positive experience.
temporal_state_chain.belief_before: Collaboration seemed promising and likely effective; they were actively working together as a team.
temporal_state_chain.belief_update: Yes; the positive outcome confirms that collaboration was successful and strengthened their professional relationship.
temporal_state_chain.belief_after: Their collaborative approach has strengthened their professional relationship and should be maintained in future projects.
temporal_state_chain.emotion: Satisfied and pleased with the outcome.
temporal_state_chain.intention: Maintain the collaborative approach in future projects and continue supporting Teresa as a colleague.
